question: In the underground gas storage cycles, by how much did extraction at the lower pressure limit of the second cycle raise the crude oil recovery?
rendered:
The document that answers this question is "Phase Behavior and Mass Transfer During Oil Reservoir Conversion to Underground Gas Storage: Effects on Storage Capacity and Recovery Efficiency".

According to the text, the extraction at the lower pressure limit of the second cycle increased the crude oil recovery rate by 6.93%.
